cues.zh: 另外，Galen 在一篇著作里说它是治腹泻的药……

cues.zh: 在另一篇里又说它是治便秘的药。
cues.en: In another he says it's a treatment for constipation.

cues.zh: 所以……嗯……
cues.en: So... Hmm...

cues.zh: 感觉就像是古怪的 Galen 的神奇药水。
cues.en: Just kind of seems like Wacky Galen's Miracle Tonic.

cues.zh: 我不太信这个叫 Galen 的家伙。
cues.en: I don't trust this Galen guy.

cues.zh: 老普林尼，我一般觉得他还比较靠谱，
cues.en: Pliny the Elder, who I usually think of as a little bit more reputable,

cues.zh: 他说这东西治狗咬和耳痛很管用，
cues.en: says that it was a good treatment for dog bites and earaches,

cues.zh: 要是你肠胃不好，最好的疗法就是吃用鱼露腌制的非洲蜗牛。
cues.en: and if you had stomach troubles, then the best cure was to eat African snails marinated in garum.

cues.zh: 哦，但蜗牛得是奇数只……
cues.en: Oh, but it needs to be an odd number of snails...

cues.zh: 因为……
cues.en: because...

cues.zh: 就是这么个讲究……
cues.en: that's a thing...

cues.zh: 不过，虽然它有药用价值，另一些人却认为这种调味料会加重痛风、引发忧郁，还会毁掉你的牙齿……
cues.en: But while it was medicinal to some others thought that the condiment exacerbated gout, caused melancholy, and destroyed your teeth...

cues.zh: 所以我都不知道该信谁了。
cues.en: So I don't know who to believe.

cues.zh: 但不管怎样，几乎每道罗马菜里都有它，它还被当作药物使用，
cues.en: But regardless the fact that it was in almost every roman dish and it was used as medicine

cues.zh: 这意味着到帝国崛起之时，它已经成了相当珍贵的商品。
cues.en: means that it had become quite the precious commodity by the time the Empire took off.

cues.zh: Garum工厂曾在地中海沿岸遍地开花。
cues.en: Garum factories were sprouting up all around the Mediterranean.

cues.zh: 在朱迪亚，人们为犹太群体制作了符合犹太教规的版本。
cues.en: In Judea, they made a kosher version for the Jewish population.

cues.zh: 在庞贝，它被称为gari flos scombri，即“Garum之花”。
cues.en: And in Pompeii, it was known as gari flos scombri, or the "Flower of Garum".

cues.zh: 如今，生产中心自然大多位于沿海，
cues.en: Now production centers tend to be, of course, on the coast

cues.zh: 因为盐分充足，而且运输鱼类大概很贵，
cues.en: because plenty of salt and moving fish probably expensive,

cues.zh: 还因为鱼必须非常新鲜。
cues.en: but also because the fish had to be very fresh.

cues.zh: 诗人马提亚尔曾说：“请接受这精致的Garum，这是用活鲭鱼流出的第一滴血制成的珍贵礼物。”
cues.en: The poet Martial said, "Accept this exquisite garum, a precious gift made with the first blood spilled from a living mackerel."

cues.zh: 但随着帝国对Garum的贪欲日益增长，沿海城镇不得不喊：“慢着，这东西太臭了！”
cues.en: But as the Empire's greed for garum grew, coastal towns had to say, "Hold your horses this stuff stinks!"

cues.zh: 《六卷书》中有一项拜占庭法规规定，任何新建的Garum工厂都必须建在
cues.en: There was a Byzantine regulation from the Hexabiblos that stated that any new garum factories needed to be built

cues.zh: 距任何村庄或城镇三斯塔德之外。
cues.en: three stades away from any village or town.

cues.zh: 大约八分之三英里。
cues.en: It's about three-eighths of a mile.

cues.zh: 我甚至不确定那是否足够
cues.en: I'm not even sure that that would be enough

cues.zh: 所以，尽管这种风味可能很美妙，
cues.en: So yeah, lovely as the flavor might be,

cues.zh: 也有人对它评价不高
cues.en: there were some that had less than great things to say about it

cues.zh: 小塞内卡在一篇伊壁鸠鲁式的激烈抨击中说道：
cues.en: In an Epicurean tirade, Seneca the Younger said,

cues.zh: “什么？难道你不认为那所谓的‘外省酱料’，
cues.en: "What? Do you not think that the so-called 'sauce from the provinces',

cues.zh: 那用有毒鱼类制成的昂贵提取物，会以其盐渍的腐烂物灼烧肠胃吗？
cues.en: the costly extract of poisonous fish, burns up the stomach with its salted putrefaction?

cues.zh: 什么？难道你不认为，一个人几乎从厨房炉火上滚烫吞下的那些变质菜肴，
cues.en: What? Do you not judge that the corrupted dishes which a man swallows almost burning from the kitchen fire,

cues.zh: 在消化系统中被消解后不会造成伤害吗？
cues.en: are quenched in the Digestive system without doing harm?

cues.zh: 那么，他们的打嗝是多么令人作呕、多么不健康，
cues.en: How repulsive then, and how unhealthy are their belchings,

cues.zh: 当人们呼出昨日纵饮的浊气时，又是多么厌恶自己！
cues.en: and how disgusted men are with themselves when they breathe forth the fumes of yesterday's debauch!

cues.zh: 你可以确定，他们的食物没有被消化，而是在腐烂。”
cues.en: You may be sure that their food is not being digested, but is rotting."

cues.zh: 这可不是鱼露的商业广告词……
cues.en: Not exactly commercial copy for garum there...

cues.zh: 就连老普林尼和马提雅尔也拿不定主意，不知自己到底对鱼露是什么感觉。
cues.en: And even Pliny the Elder and Martial had trouble making up their mind about how they really felt about garum.

cues.zh: 马提雅尔曾称赞一个年轻人向一位当晚已经吃了六份鱼露的女士求爱
cues.en: Martial once commended a young man for making romantic advances toward a woman who had already had six helpings of the stuff that night

cues.zh: 而老普林尼曾称它为骄傲的酱汁和精致的烈酒，
cues.en: and Pliny the Elder, who had called it proud sauce and exquisite liquor,

cues.zh: 他也把鱼露描述为“鱼的内脏和其他本应被视为废弃物的部分，
cues.en: also described garum as "the guts of fish and other parts that would otherwise be considered refuse,

cues.zh: 所以鱼露实际上是腐烂物质的分泌物。”
cues.en: so that garum is really the secretion of putrefying matter."

cues.zh: 他说得有点道理，但严格来说，它不是腐烂，而是发酵。
cues.en: And he's kind of right, but, to be pedantic, it is not putrid but rather fermented.

cues.zh: 盐在那里阻止腐烂，
cues.en: With the salt there to stop putrefaction,

cues.zh: 分解实际上来自鱼自身消化系统中的酶
cues.en: the breakdown actually comes from enzymes in the fish's own digestive system

cues.zh: 所以本质上，它在几个月的时间里消化自己
cues.en: so that essentially it's digesting itself over the period of several months

cues.zh: 有点像沙拉克坑……
cues.en: Kind of like the sarlacc pit...

cues.zh: 总之，咱们回到厨房里那个自己的沙拉克坑吧。
cues.en: Anyway, let's get back to our own sarlacc pit in the kitchen.

cues.zh: 鱼煮上30到40分钟后，
cues.en: So once the fish has boiled for 30 to 40 minutes,

cues.en: take it off the heat and let it cool. Then pour it through a colander.

cues.en: Now, it says to strain it two or three times

cues.en: The best thing that I actually used was a paper towel and then a tea towel.

cues.en: So here is my bottle of garum: a nice kind of pale yellow color.

cues.en: but you do need to make sure that the bottles have been sterilized.

cues.en: So, you know... boil those bottles.

cues.zh: 意思是：你。不。能。喝。Garum。
cues.en: Or: You. Do. Not. Drink. Garum.

cues.zh: 但我真的很想在把它加到别的菜里之前，先尝尝它的纯正形态。
cues.en: But I really want to try it in its pure form before I add it to another dish.

cues.zh: 幸运的是，老普林尼说过，如果把它稀释到蜂蜜酒的颜色，你就可以直接喝了。
cues.en: And luckily Pliny the Elder says that if you dilute it to the color of honey wine, you can go ahead and drink it.

cues.en: So before I try it - I've diluted a glass here - I'm going to first tell you how it smells in its purest form so...
